import struct, glob, os

def tables(path):
 data=open(path,'rb').read()
 if len(data)<12: return {}
 sfnt,num=struct.unpack('>IH',data[:6])
 d={}
 for i in range(num):
  off=12+i*16
  tag,chk,o,l=struct.unpack('>4sIII',data[off:off+16])
  d[tag.decode('latin1')]=(o,l,data[o:o+l])
 return d
for f in glob.glob('test/shaping/data/**/*.ttf',recursive=True)+glob.glob('test/shaping/data/**/*.otf',recursive=True):
 d=tables(f)
 if 'morx' in d:
  o,l,m=d['morx']
  print('\n',f, 'morx',o,l, m[:32].hex())
  # parse header and chains
  if len(m)>=8:
   ver,unused,cc=struct.unpack('>HHI',m[:8])
   print(' ver',ver,'cc',cc)
   p=8
   for ci in range(min(cc,3)):
    if p+16>len(m): break
    default,length,fc,sc=struct.unpack('>IIII',m[p:p+16])
    print(' chain',ci,'at',p,'default',hex(default),'len',length,'fc',fc,'sc',sc)
    q=p+16+fc*12
    for si in range(min(sc,5)):
     if q+12>len(m): break
     slen,cov,flags=struct.unpack('>III',m[q:q+12])
     print('  sub',si,'at',q,'len',slen,'cov',hex(cov),'type',cov&0xff,'flags',hex(flags),'after',m[q+12:q+40].hex())
     q+=slen
    p+=length

import struct, glob, os
def tables(path):
 data=open(path,'rb').read()
 if len(data)<12: return {}
 sfnt,num=struct.unpack('>IH',data[:6])
 d={}
 for i in range(num):
  off=12+i*16
  tag,chk,o,l=struct.unpack('>4sIII',data[off:off+16])
  d[tag.decode('latin1')]=(o,l,data[o:o+l])
 return d
for f in glob.glob('test/shaping/data/**/*.ttf',recursive=True)+glob.glob('test/shaping/data/**/*.otf',recursive=True):
 d=tables(f)
 if 'morx' in d:
  o,l,m=d['morx']
  print('\n',f, 'morx',o,l, m[:32].hex())
  # parse header and chains
  if len(m)>=8:
   ver,unused,cc=struct.unpack('>HHI',m[:8])
   print(' ver',ver,'cc',cc)
   p=8
   for ci in range(min(cc,3)):
    if p+16>len(m): break
    default,length,fc,sc=struct.unpack('>IIII',m[p:p+16])
    print(' chain',ci,'at',p,'default',hex(default),'len',length,'fc',fc,'sc',sc)
    q=p+16+fc*12
    for si in range(min(sc,5)):
     if q+12>len(m): break
     slen,cov,flags=struct.unpack('>III',m[q:q+12])
     print('  sub',si,'at',q,'len',slen,'cov',hex(cov),'type',cov&0xff,'flags',hex(flags),'after',m[q+12:q+40].hex())
     q+=slen
    p+=length
